morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，末尾 i 不是马来语后缀。输入将其解析为 bikin 的派生词有误；本条纠正为独立词基 bikini，词基爪夷文相应为 بيکيني。ber- + bikini → berbikini，无词首音交替。

senses.zh_definition: 比基尼泳装：由胸罩式上装和短裤式下装组成，供女性游泳或日光浴时穿着的两件式泳装。
senses.en_definition: A women's two-piece swimsuit consisting of a bra-like top and briefs, worn for swimming or sunbathing.
senses.ms_definition: Pakaian yang terdiri daripada semacam coli dan seluar dalam, yang dipakai oleh wanita untuk berenang atau berjemur.
senses.nuances: 指泳装类别，并不因为外形类似内衣就等同于普通内衣。马来语释义依据输入的《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》释义展开缩写；berbikini 意为穿着比基尼泳装。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=172780&keyword=bikini)

dual_scenarios.context: 零售介绍 / 商品说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Koleksi pakaian renang baharu itu merangkumi bikini dalam pelbagai saiz dan warna.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这套新泳装系列包括多种尺码和颜色的比基尼。
dual_scenarios.en: The new swimwear collection includes bikinis in various sizes and colours.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Bikini biru tu dah masuk beg ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah bikini biru itu sudah dimasukkan ke dalam beg?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那套蓝色比基尼放进包里了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you packed that blue bikini yet?

etymology.historical_story: The swimsuit name bikini comes from Bikini Atoll in the Pacific, associated with nuclear weapons testing in 1946. Louis Réard presented his design in Paris that July, while Jacques Heim also promoted a competing minimal swimsuit. The geographical name became an international clothing term. Its final i is therefore part of the borrowed word, not a Malay suffix. [Metropolitan Museum of Art](https://www.metmuseum.org/pt/essays/the-bikini)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bi—ki—ni，三个音节直接对应中文“比基尼”；把整词和上下两件泳装的画面一起记。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的服装名称。购物或讨论泳装时可以直接使用，但不宜借此评论他人的身体或道德。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于泳装销售、旅行和游泳话题。实际穿着应遵循场所的着装规定，并尊重个人与宗教习惯；不预设所有泳池或海滩的要求相同。
